_doc: Route of the high pill game on the scroll figure (textures/gui/flow/scroll_body.png). Points are in FIGURE UV space (0..1 of the png, x right, y down) in the ORDER of the game's way: dantian, up the screen-left side, shoulder, down the arm (outer lane) to the palm and back up (inner lane), across the collar, other shoulder, down that arm (inner lane) and back (outer lane), down the screen-right side, dantian. The route is a closed loop, so the last point equals the first. After swapping the png, move only these points. 'figure' places the png on the paper (fractions of the paper width / height).
